Perfect for blues guitar and fusion tones Jef Stone · Mar 5, 2024 Contains affiliate links Calling all tone enthusiasts! This new AmpMojo Sol Drive guitar pedal promises to deliver the legendary overdrive tones of D-style tube amps favored by blues and fusion giants like SRV, Robben Ford, and Larry Carlton. Powered by a Tung-Sol 12AX7. AmpMojo Sol - Drive D-Style Overdrive Inspired by the iconic sounds of these amps, AmpMojo's Sol Drive aims to be the ultimate overdrive solution. At its core lies a genuine Tung-Sol 12AX7 preamp tube – synonymous with harmonic richness and vintage warmth . The tube sits in a rugged, tour-ready enclosure with an authentic amplifier socket for maximum reliability. This pedal accommodates other pre-amp tubes such as 7025, 12AT7, 5751, or similar. This allows users to experiment with the tone by trying our new tubes in the socket. Making it perfect for blues guitar and fusion tones. D-Style overdrive pedal Two Tone Hounds AmpMojo was formed by Brian Shira and Dan Shugar ; the pair uses authentic analog circuits to make their products, which are designed to be roadworthy and to stand the test of time. Their Sol Drive is a medium gain, responsive tube overdrive pedal. It uses a dual triode pre-amp tube to bring a rich harmonic texture to your tone. Players, including Jack Ryan Sullivan and Johnny Hiland, are both expressing their love for this new tube-driven stompbox. Key Features: Gain Control: Dial in anything from subtle grit to full-blown overdrive. Voice Knob: Tailor your tone with precise low-end and mid-frequency shaping. Tone Control: Smooth out high frequencies for a perfectly balanced sound. Level Control: Set the perfect output level. Top-mounted Jacks: Convenient placement saves pedalboard space. True Bypass Operation: Pure signal integrity when the pedal's off. Made in the USA: Quality craftsmanship ensures roadworthiness. Pricing and Availability: Get the Sol Drive for $299 directly from AmpMojo's website . If you enjoy great overdrive pedals and drive tones, then be sure to read our Best Overdrive Pedals, No Bad Monkeys!
